name: mcode_read_file
description: Read a file OR list a directory in the workspace. Pass path relative to the repo root (/workspace/app); omit for the root. For a file returns { kind:'file', content, size, binary, truncated } (binary files are base64, files capped at 1 MiB). For a directory returns { kind:'dir', entries:[{name,is_dir}] }. Use this to explore code before editing.

path.description: Path relative to the repo root; omit for the root.
